name: Deore II thumb-shifter pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 232 g for the complete left/right SL-MT62 seven-speed thumb-shifter pair, with 22.2 mm clamps and SIS/friction switching. The catalogue explicitly says pair; cable and housing inclusion is not specified.
